source.designSystem: Fictional example brand (replace with a link to your design system)
source.note: tokens.json, README.md and components.md are the design system's own files. Change the system first, then re-import; don't edit the copies here.

rules.notes: forbidJustify: README rule 5. extraAlphas: the photo scrim, night 72% to 0%.

icon.notes: 24-unit grid, 2 stroke, round caps and joins, no fills; fjord or ink on light grounds, paper on dark.

web.notes: Sizes in px; brand_css turns fluid ranges into clamp() between 375 and 1440px viewports.

layout.notes: Web layout of the example brand. Your own brand can mark values "proposed" until they are signed off.
